component.name: R-TrustTunnel
component.summary: Manage TrustTunnel profiles and connect your VPN

description.p: A native Wayland client for TrustTunnel with encrypted profile storage, file and tt link import, server synchronization and a desktop tray.
System VPN requires the separate R-TrustTunnel host service. The sandbox accesses only its authenticated VPN API. SOCKS mode works without the host service.
